title: Blaxsmith project file (.blaxsmith.json), version 1
description: Committed at the repository root. Blaxsmith reads it at the project's pinned commit to suggest verification checks, setup commands, and a recipe. Suggestions are prefilled for a person to confirm; nothing is saved automatically.

verification.description: Checks a run must pass, each an exact argv (no shell).

setup.description: Commands that prepare a workspace, such as installing dependencies.

recipe.description: Name of a library recipe to preselect for new runs.
